I wrote `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout and fonts are unchecked.

The page is a 1280px `#component` with the heading and the General, Notifications and Danger zone sections, using your exact copy. It is static HTML and CSS only.

- **Palette and type:** I used only the DESIGN.md colors and sizes. The page heading is Unbounded Light caps at 56px, the section titles are Unbounded Medium at 28px, and the body is Archivo.
- **Fonts:** No font files were provided, so the CSS names Unbounded and Archivo and falls back to system fonts. The type will only look as designed where those fonts are installed.
- **Switches:** They are real checkboxes with `role="switch"`, so they work with a keyboard and without JavaScript. "Email me when a request is assigned to me" and "Weekly summary" start on, and "Product updates" starts off. I chose those starting states myself, since the brief didn't give any.
- **Danger zone:** The palette has no red, so the Danger zone card has an ink border and "Delete Workspace" is a quiet outlined button. "Save Changes" is the only filled primary button.
- **Ignored files:** `session.json` is empty and `session.err` only holds a model-name error, so I ignored both.
